when: 작업 흐름 전체를 보여 줄 때
draw: a full computer monitor view seen straight on, with simple window panes and blocks standing in for an application

when: 한 영역·한 값에 시선을 모을 때
draw: a close crop of one region of a screen, one block much larger than the rest with a bold hollow rectangle around it

when: 눈에 안 보이는 구조·흐름을 그림으로 풀 때
draw: a flat schematic diagram on empty paper with no perspective and no device or desk around it, showing only the shapes named in the scene and nothing extra
an almost empty frame with one large simple symbol in the center and wide blank margins
a close view of two hands typing on a keyboard seen from above, the monitor edge soft in the background

when: 시청자가 직접 하는 느낌이 필요할 때
draw: a first-person view looking down past the viewer's own hands at a desk, monitor and objects in front

when: 사람이 있어야 하지만 얼굴은 드러내지 않을 때
draw: a person seen from behind sitting or walking, shoulders and back of the head only, facing a monitor or a view

when: 장소의 크기·분위기를 먼저 보여 줄 때
draw: a wide landscape or street scene with a clear horizon, tiny figure shapes far away, depth from foreground to background

when: 작은 사물 하나가 이야기를 대신할 때
draw: one everyday object filling most of the frame, resting on a plain surface, shallow depth with a soft blurred background
a row of three small frames showing the same fixed viewpoint, the light and shadows changing from one frame to the next

when: 근거 자료나 기록 사진을 잠깐 끼울 때
draw: a flat document or photo shape laid slightly tilted on a plain surface, with simple block shapes standing in for its content
